title: Synthesize customer-facing change brief and internal handoff
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: produce a concise customer-facing "change brief" that summarizes behavior changes, upgrade impact, and recommended actions, plus an internal one-page handoff for support, sales, and solutions engineering. We must harmonize messaging across Console, API, and Dedicated customers while preserving accuracy for Private deployments. Deliverables: 1) Customer change brief (HTML + plaintext) for the portal and support templates; 2) Internal one-pager (FAQ + triage checklist); 3) Slack announcement + comms schedule; 4) Signoff matrix and distribution list.
acceptance_criteria: Customer brief reviewed and approved by Product, Legal, and Security (signoffs recorded)
Internal handoff document covers: regression risk, customer impact buckets, escalation contacts, rollback guidance
Support and Sales confirm templated responses for top 5 expected questions
Release assets uploaded to shared Drive and linked in Release Playbook
Timing windows and targeted customer segments defined (hosted, dedicated, private)
tasks: Draft initial change brief (Aisha) — include TL;DR, impact table, and action required section
Technical accuracy review (Luca) — confirm API examples and migration steps
Legal and Privacy review (Esther) — ensure no regulated data statements required
Security review (Ravi) — confirm KMS/HSM notes and audit log disclaimers
Support template creation (Marta) — canned replies and triage checklist
Sales enablement slide (Ben) — one slide summarizing upsell/ps implications
Finalize distribution list and schedule (Aisha) — internal Slack + email + portal
